name: Oracle Database
sku: Oracle Database, self-managed, documentation for the current release (Oracle AI Database). Autonomous Database, GoldenGate and APEX are separate records.

source.oltp.note: A relational, object-relational database with ACID transactions and multiuser concurrency, used as the system of record behind applications.

serve.query-engine.note: All operations on the data are performed with SQL statements. It is a general-purpose engine rather than one built only for analytics; the warehouse workload is scored under Autonomous Database.

transform.code-transform.note: PL/SQL, a procedural extension to SQL, lets business logic be stored and run in the database, alongside Java and JavaScript.

orchestrate.scheduling.note: The Scheduler (DBMS_SCHEDULER) runs jobs on calendar schedules such as daily, weekly or last day of month.

orchestrate.dependency-dag.note: Job chains link a named series of steps with dependencies and control flow. They orchestrate work inside the database only.

orchestrate.event-triggers.note: Event-based jobs start when an event arrives through Advanced Queuing, or when a file watcher sees a file arrive on a local or remote system.

bands.note: Data Redaction obscures values in query results at runtime, by full, partial, regular-expression, random or null redaction, without changing the stored data. The documentation page does not state which licence or option it needs, so check your agreement.

presentation.tagline: Enterprise relational database: the system of record behind many applications.
